head: Memorandum of understanding between the records office and the facilities group. The parties agree to a joint review of the intake queue before the next quarterly cycle. The review covers staffing, retention schedule alignment, and the shared index. Effective 2025-03-04. Point of contact for scheduling is the records office coordinator.

Statement of work for a document scanning pilot. The vendor will digitize a bounded sample of bound volumes at 300 dots per inch and deliver searchable text alongside the images. Term runs 2025-04-15 through 2025-07-15. Acceptance is by sampling of fifty pages per box. Deliverables are text, image, and a manifest.

Meeting minutes of the operations working group. Present: three staff and two guests. The group reviewed the backlog report and agreed to schedule a second pass on the oldest boxes. Action item: draft a retention note by 2025-06-01. No budget decisions were made. Next meeting 2025-06-10.

Quarterly status report. The pilot completed 12,400 pages against a target of 10,000. Two defects were logged, both corrected. Throughput held steady after the equipment swap. The team recommends extending the pilot one quarter. No dates are asserted for the extension decision.

Employee handbook excerpt. Records are retained according to the published schedule. Personal information is minimized and access is limited to authorized staff. Questions about a specific record go to the records office. This excerpt carries no program name and no dates.

Release notes for the intake tool version 2.3. Added a duplicate check and a batched export. Fixed a display bug in the queue view. Known issue: the export omits an empty column. Released 2025-08-12. Upgrade is in place and does not require downtime.
